subject: compRelSEM error when using lavaan.mi object

messages.author: 8b72cc77f6367898
messages.subject: compRelSEM error when using lavaan.mi object
parts:
Hello,

 

I've been trying to obtain composite reliability estimates for a grouped sem model with multiple imputed data, but I keep running into an error that doesn't appear when I use a single imputed dataset:

 

My model:

cfa_attitude<-'

#measurement model

norm=~Q20a+Q20b+Q20c+Q20c+Q20d

attitude=~Q19a+Q19b+Q19c+Q19d

PBC=~Q20e+Q21a+Q21b+Q21c+Q21d+Q21e+Q21f

dist=~Q23a+Q23b+Q23c

ccatt=~Q24a+Q24b+Q24c+Q24d+Q24e+Q24f

'

 

Running the model on multiple imputed data and error:

out2 <- runMI(cfa_attitude,

              data=mice.imp,

              group="Q4",

              fun="sem",

              group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"),

              meanstructure = TRUE,

              std.lv=T)

compRelSEM(out2)

Error in SIGMA[[b]][fIndNames, fIndNames, drop = FALSE] :

  no 'dimnames' attribute for array

 

Running the same model on single imputed data works fine:

test<-sem(cfa_attitude, data=mice.imp[[1]], group="Q4",group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"),

              meanstructure = TRUE,

              std.lv=T)

compRelSEM(test)

  group  norm attitude   PBC  dist ccatt

1     1 0.761    0.928 0.794 0.718 0.710

2     2 0.835    0.898 0.900 0.818 0.676

 

I would appreciate any help debugging that, as I'm not sure where the error is coming from. Other functions (such as summary or LavTestLRt) work fine with the multiple imputed data.

 

Thank you and best wishes,

Živa
